name: Gripmend Adjustable Tool Belt — 12-Loop
description: Wide nylon webbing tool belt in faded olive with twelve reinforced loop holders, two zippered side pouches, and a center drop-holster for a power driver. The buckle is a heavy-duty ratchet clasp worn smooth from daily use. Several loops are stretched or stained in ways that tell a story of regular, specific tools.
functionality: Distributes up to 8kg of tool weight evenly across the hips; magnetic tool-retention strips inside each loop prevent drop in low-gravity or vibration environments.
what_it_says: Every loop is filled, every placement is deliberate — this person knows exactly what they need and where it lives.
story_hooks: One pouch is sewn shut from the inside — whatever was stored there, the owner doesn't want easy access to it anymore.
A specific loop configuration on a belt matches a schematic for a piece of equipment that was supposedly decommissioned.
